_readme: Launch Week data: real launches only (the placeholders are in data/launches.samples.json). The steps from a maker's assets to a
live launch are in README.md (Launch Week: from assets to a live launch). In short:
npm run launch:draft -- --email <file> | --submission <file>   draft an entry from a maker's email or a /submit/ row (writes nothing here)
npm run launch:draft -- --add <draft.json>                     add a reviewed draft to this file
npm run launch:check       the preflight: fields, links, images (sizes, formats, alt text), date, facts, listing
npm run seed:check         validate this file and print what would be loaded (changes nothing)
npm run seed:preview       load it, plus the samples, into the preview database
npm run seed:remote        load it into the live D1 database (founder's approval first; samples are refused there)
Maker images go in public/launches/<slug>/ and are referenced as /launches/<slug>/logo.png etc.
Re-running the seed updates entries in place and never touches votes. Use --prune to also remove launches deleted from this file.
